# Data Cleaning

## Enactment Status - outcome variable

``` r

install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("readr")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("stringr")
install.packages("writexl")

library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)

# Read the files
setwd("/Users/patrickheldebrandt/Desktop/Knowledge_Mining_R")
enactment <- read_excel("ai_definitions_extracted_with_covars (1).xlsx", sheet = "in")

#
enactment <- enactment %>%
  mutate(
    status = str_trim(status),
    adopted = if_else(
      str_starts(status,"Enacted") |
      str_starts(status, "Adopted"),
      1,
      0
    )
  )

write_xlsx(enactment, "ai_definitions_extracted_with_DV.xlsx")
```

## State Partisanship

``` r

install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("readr")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("stringr")
install.packages("writexl")

library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)


setwd("/Users/patrickheldebrandt/Desktop/Knowledge_Mining_R")
bills <- read_excel("us_ai_legislation_ncsl_meta 1.xls", sheet = "us_ai_legislation_ncsl_meta 1")
state_lookup <- read_csv("state_partisan_control_2025-2024.csv")


# 2. Extract year
bills <- bills %>%
  mutate(
    bill_year = str_sub(as.character(year), 1, 4)
  )


bills <- bills %>%
  left_join(state_lookup, by = "state") %>%
  mutate(
    state_partisanship = case_when(
      bill_year == "2023" ~ state_control_2023,
      bill_year == "2024" ~ state_control_2024,
      bill_year == "2025" ~ state_control_2025,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# standarize
bills <- bills %>%
  mutate(
    state_partisanship = case_when(
      state_partisanship == "Rep" ~ "Republican",
      state_partisanship == "Dem" ~ "Democrat",
      state_partisanship == "Divided" ~ "Divided",
      TRUE ~ state_partisanship
    )
  )

# remove lookup column
bills <- bills %>%
  select(
    everything(),
    -leg_control_2023, -gov_party_2023, -state_control_2023,
    -leg_control_2025, -gov_party_2025, -state_control_2025,
    -leg_control_2024, -gov_party_2024, -state_control_2024
  )

# Export
write_xlsx(bills, "ai_definitions_with_state_partisanship.xlsx")
write_csv(bills, "ai_definitions_with_state_partisanship.csv")

table(bills$bill_year, useNA = "ifany")
table(bills$state_partisanship, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(bills$state_partisanship))

bills %>%
  select(state, year, bill_year, state_partisanship) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Author Partisanship using Legiscan API

``` r

install.packages(c(
  "readxl", "writexl", "dplyr", "stringr",
  "purrr", "httr", "jsonlite", "tibble"
))

library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tibble)


setwd("/Users/patrickheldebrandt/Desktop/Knowledge_Mining_R")

input_file  <- "Book5.xlsx"
output_file <- "us_ai_legislation_with_authors_legiscan.xlsx"

LEGISCAN_KEY <- "2ecd4e5a2ec496148bddf44f58177237"


bills <- read_excel(input_file)

if (!"author" %in% names(bills)) {
  bills$author <- NA_character_
}

# Clean

bills <- bills %>%
  mutate(
    author = as.character(author),
    year = as.integer(year),
    
    bill_id_original = as.character(bill_id),
    
    state_abbr = str_extract(str_to_upper(bill_id_original), "^[A-Z]{2}"),
    
    bill_part = str_trim(str_replace(str_to_upper(bill_id_original), "^[A-Z]{2}\\s*", "")),
    
    bill_prefix = str_extract(bill_part, "^[A-Z]+"),
    
    bill_digits = str_extract(bill_part, "[0-9]+"),
    
    # LegiScan format
    bill_number = case_when(
      bill_prefix == "H" ~ paste0("HB", bill_digits),
      bill_prefix == "S" ~ paste0("SB", bill_digits),
      bill_prefix == "A" ~ paste0("AB", bill_digits),
      TRUE ~ paste0(bill_prefix, bill_digits)
    )
  )

###
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

legiscan_get <- function(params) {
  response <- tryCatch(
    GET(
      "https://api.legiscan.com/",
      query = c(key = LEGISCAN_KEY, params)
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(response) || http_error(response)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  txt <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    fromJSON(txt, simplifyVector = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
  out
}
###


get_sessions_for_state <- function(state_abbr) {
  res <- legiscan_get(list(
    op = "getSessionList",
    state = state_abbr
  ))
  
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$sessions)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  map_dfr(res$sessions, function(x) {
    tibble(
      session_id = x$session_id %||% NA_integer_,
      year_start = x$year_start %||% NA_integer_,
      year_end = x$year_end %||% NA_integer_,
      special = x$special %||% NA_integer_,
      session_name = x$session_name %||% NA_character_
    )
  })
}


get_master_list <- function(session_id) {
  res <- legiscan_get(list(
    op = "getMasterList",
    id = session_id
  ))
  
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$masterlist)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  items <- res$masterlist
  items <- items[names(items) != "session"]
  
  map_dfr(items, function(x) {
    tibble(
      legiscan_bill_id = x$bill_id %||% NA_integer_,
      number = x$number %||% x$bill_number %||% NA_character_,
      title_api = x$title %||% NA_character_
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      number_clean = str_to_upper(str_replace_all(number, "\\s+", ""))
    )
}


session_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

get_state_year_master <- function(state_abbr, year) {
  cache_key <- paste(state_abbr, year, sep = "_")
  
  if (exists(cache_key, envir = session_cache)) {
    return(get(cache_key, envir = session_cache))
  }
  
  sessions <- get_sessions_for_state(state_abbr)
  
  if (nrow(sessions) == 0) {
    out <- tibble()
    assign(cache_key, out, envir = session_cache)
    return(out)
  }
  
  possible_sessions <- sessions %>%
    filter(
      year >= year_start,
      year <= year_end
    )
  
  if (nrow(possible_sessions) == 0) {
    possible_sessions <- sessions %>%
      filter(year_start == year | year_end == year)
  }
  
  if (nrow(possible_sessions) == 0) {
    out <- tibble()
    assign(cache_key, out, envir = session_cache)
    return(out)
  }
  
  out <- map_dfr(possible_sessions$session_id, function(sid) {
    get_master_list(sid) %>%
      mutate(session_id = sid)
  })
  
  assign(cache_key, out, envir = session_cache)
  out
}

# Match the bills
find_legiscan_bill_id <- function(state_abbr, year, bill_number) {
  master <- get_state_year_master(state_abbr, year)
  
  if (nrow(master) == 0) {
    return(list(
      id = NA_integer_,
      status = "no session/master list"
    ))
  }
  
  bill_number_clean <- str_to_upper(str_replace_all(bill_number, "\\s+", ""))
  
  matched <- master %>%
    filter(number_clean == bill_number_clean)
  
  if (nrow(matched) == 0) {
    close_matches <- master %>%
      filter(str_detect(number_clean, str_extract(bill_number_clean, "[0-9]+"))) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      pull(number) %>%
      paste(collapse = ", ")
    
    return(list(
      id = NA_integer_,
      status = paste0(
        "no exact match for ", bill_number_clean,
        "; close number matches: ", close_matches
      )
    ))
  }
  
  list(
    id = matched$legiscan_bill_id[1],
    status = paste("matched", matched$number[1], "in session", matched$session_id[1])
  )
}

# find author and partisanship
get_bill_author <- function(legiscan_bill_id) {
  if (is.na(legiscan_bill_id)) {
    return("N/A")
  }
  
  res <- legiscan_get(list(
    op = "getBill",
    id = legiscan_bill_id
  ))
  
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$bill) || is.null(res$bill$sponsors)) {
    return("N/A")
  }
  
  sponsors <- res$bill$sponsors
  
  if (length(sponsors) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }
  
  sponsor_df <- map_dfr(sponsors, function(x) {
    tibble(
      name = x$name %||% NA_character_,
      sponsor_type_id = x$sponsor_type_id %||% NA_integer_,
      sponsor_order = x$sponsor_order %||% NA_integer_
    )
  }) %>%
    filter(!is.na(name), name != "")
  
  if (nrow(sponsor_df) == 0) {
    return("N/A")
  }
  
  primary <- sponsor_df %>%
    filter(sponsor_type_id == 1 | sponsor_order == 1)
  
  if (nrow(primary) > 0) {
    return(paste(unique(primary$name), collapse = "; "))
  }
  
  paste(unique(sponsor_df$name), collapse = "; ")
}


bills$legiscan_bill_id <- NA_integer_
bills$legiscan_match_status <- NA_character_

rows_to_fill <- which(
  is.na(bills$author) |
    bills$author == "" |
    bills$author == "N/A"
)

for (i in rows_to_fill) {
  cat("\nProcessing row", i, "of", nrow(bills), "\n")
  cat("Original bill_id:", bills$bill_id_original[i], "\n")
  cat("Using:", bills$state_abbr[i], bills$bill_number[i], bills$year[i], "\n")
  
  match_result <- find_legiscan_bill_id(
    state_abbr = bills$state_abbr[i],
    year = bills$year[i],
    bill_number = bills$bill_number[i]
  )
  
  bills$legiscan_bill_id[i] <- match_result$id
  bills$legiscan_match_status[i] <- match_result$status
  
  bills$author[i] <- get_bill_author(match_result$id)
  
  cat("Match:", match_result$status, "\n")
  cat("Author:", bills$author[i], "\n")
}

# export 
bills <- bills %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "bill_part",
    "bill_prefix",
    "bill_digits"
  )))

# write_xlsx(bills, output_file)

cat("\nDone. File saved as:", output_file, "\n")
```
